name: dsh-gitbash-shell
description: Windows 上给 agent 一个真正的 Git Bash 命令工具:私有 Git Bash 执行器实例(官方 PowerShell 执行器原样保留),统一 MSYS 盘根路径方言,官方 pwsh 工具默认隐藏可开关,物化四个内置预设的 Git Bash 变体,侧栏终端接管可开关。· Give agents a real Git Bash tool on Windows: a private Git Bash executor instance (the official PowerShell executor stays untouched), a unified MSYS drive-root path dialect, an opt-in official pwsh tool, and four Git Bash preset variants.

scripts.test: node --test tests/smoke.mjs tests/private-executor.mjs tests/client-regressions.mjs tests/bridge-regressions.mjs tests/runtime-regressions.mjs tests/host-regressions.mjs tests/compatibility-regressions.mjs tests/path-tool.mjs tests/native-output.mjs tests/native-executor.mjs
scripts.test:preview: node --import ./tests/host-loader.mjs --import ./tests/preview-env.mjs --test tests/preview.mjs tests/bridge-preview.mjs tests/runtime-preview.mjs tests/host-preview.mjs tests/path-preview.mjs tests/native-output-preview.mjs tests/native-preview.mjs tests/native-integration-preview.mjs
